title: Subaru High-z Exploration of Low-Luminosity Quasars (SHELLQs). VIII. A less biased view of the early co-evolution of black holes and host galaxies
question: Do low-luminosity z>6 quasars follow the local M_BH-M_bulge relation, and what are their [CII] and FIR properties, in a less luminosity-biased sample?

data.sensitivity: [CII] cube rms 0.10, 0.10, 0.11 mJy/beam per 100 km/s; continuum rms 16.3, 11.2, 19.1 uJy/beam

what.value: Mg II-based M_BH of J1208-0200 and J2239+0207, Mg II redshifts, CIV blueshifts

evidence.quote: $M_{\rm BH}$ of J1208$-$0200 and J2239+0207 are measured with Mg  emission line, which are reported in (cite: Onoue19).

what.value: Literature compilation of M_BH, M_1450, L_FIR, [CII] data for z>~6 quasars

evidence.quote: We also compiled $M_{\rm BH}$ and $M_{\rm 1450}$ values of other $z \geq 5.7$ quasars from the literature
In (cite: 2018PASJ...70...36I), we presented Cycle 4 ALMA observations toward four $z \gtrsim 6$ HSC quasars in the [C ] line and 1.2 mm continuum.

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image cubes and continuum
recipe.method: CASA calibration; clean with Briggs weighting; uv-plane continuum subtraction; channels binned to ~100 km/s
Single Gaussian fit to 1 arcsec aperture spectra for z, FWHM, flux; L_CII from standard equation
2D Gaussian fit to moment 0 maps at original resolution

recipe.goal: Derive FIR luminosity, SFR, dust mass
recipe.method: Graybody scaling of 1.2 mm flux in 1 arcsec aperture; L_FIR over 42.5-122.5 um; SFR_TIR and SFR_CII relations; dust mass from kappa
Thin disk: v_circ=0.75 FWHM/sin i, D=1.5 a_maj, M_dyn=1.16e5 v^2 D
assumptions: Thin rotating circular disk; inclination from axis ratio

recipe.goal: Compare M_BH-M_dyn and L_Bol-L_FIR with literature
recipe.method: Compiled literature quasars; linear regression with upper limits via IRAF STSDAS; Spearman tests
assumptions: Eddington-limited accretion where no Mg II M_BH; bolometric correction 4.4

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges used for the continuum
Cell size, image size, masks and clean threshold
Velocity range for moment 0 maps (only given for J2239+0207)
Aperture centering and spectrum extraction details for the 1 arcsec aperture
Gaussian fit initial conditions and baseline treatment for line fits
Radiative efficiency eta used for Mdot_BH
Inclination handling for sources with axis ratios near unity
score_reason: Data and main steps stated; imaging details and literature compilation partly missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data from a single ALMA project, simple recipe, numeric results in tables.
